Open datasets of interest to Portuguese civil society. Last reviewed: October 2026.

```{python}
#| echo: false
import pandas as pd
from itables import init_notebook_mode, show

init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False)

df = pd.read_csv("resources/datasets.csv")
df["link"] = df["link"].apply(lambda u: f'<a href="{u}">link</a>')
show(df, classes="display compact", columnDefs=[{"className": "dt-left", "targets": "_all"}])
```
